name: Santeria
overview: Santeria, as a syncretic system involving worship of spirits and images, directly conflicts with biblical commands to avoid idolatry and spiritism. Scripture warns believers not to bow down to other gods or follow the practices of pagan lands, emphasizing the need to utterly overthrow such images and reject familiar spirits and wizards (Exodus 23:24; Leviticus 18:3; 19:31). True worship honors God alone, who is Spirit and must be worshiped in spirit and truth (John 4:24), recognizing Him as the sovereign Creator who sustains all things (Amos 9:6). Therefore, Christians are called to cast out Santeria influences and cling to exclusive devotion to the LORD.
